output.reason: Evidence shows Schedule II, row 3 includes a “Pre-payment charge” equal to 2% of principal outstanding, payable on pre-payment or foreclosure. It also cites UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(3) stating “prepayment charge not_applicable.” Since the claim states the current rule position says the pre-payment charge is not applicable while the agreement includes such a charge, that conflict is supported by the evidence.
